header.description: Two-ship gun-kill scenario pinning G2 hit detection + per-aircraft hitpoints (Step 7 guns, seal v1.10r0). AC0 (P-47D) sits in a co-altitude tail chase ~393 m behind AC1 (A6M2), same heading (due east along the equator), and fires a 20-round burst over ticks 0-19. The faster rounds (muzzle 1050 m/s vs the target's 150 m/s) overtake AC1; each round that passes within 60 m horizontally (spherical law-of-cosines test cosc>COS_HIT_ANGLE) AND 60 m vertically of the ALIVE target deals the P-47D's per-round 12 hp (G3) into the TAIL region from dead astern and despawns. SIX rounds connect -- MEASURED under v1.24r0 sigma-scaled round drag at ticks 39/41/44/47/50/53 (the faster thin-air rounds pulled the three mid-burst connects one tick earlier than the v1.22r0-v1.23r0 story's 42/45/48; the first, fifth, and killing ticks are unchanged) -- walking the A6M2's hp 70 -> 58 -> 46 -> 34 -> 22 -> 10 -> 0: on the 6th connect at tick 53 AC1 is DEAD: its flight integration is skipped (it freezes at the kill position) and it can no longer be hit, so the remaining rounds of the burst pass through the corpse and coast on. At tick 200 AC0 is alive (hp 150, flew on east, kills 1) and AC1 is dead (hp 0, tail 0, last_hit_by 0, frozen), with one spent round still airborne. Exercises: hit geometry, damage accumulation, the kill/freeze, self-hit immunity (AC0 never hits itself), and dead-target pass-through. Both stay co-altitude so the vertical gate is satisfied. NEW golden for G2.
